title: Pteranodon: Complete Overview
name: Pteranodon: Complete Overview
description: Pteranodon ("toothless wing") was a piscivore dinosaur of the Late Cretaceous (86-84 million years ago), reaching about 7 m wingspan. Crested flying reptile (not a dinosaur). This record is the front door to the Pteranodon database: what it is, why it matters, and how the other records in this archive fit together.

# Pteranodon — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What does the name Pteranodon mean?", "toothless wing"),
    ("What did Pteranodon eat?", "piscivore"),
    ("What is name meaning?", "toothless wing"),
    ("What is period?", "Late Cretaceous"),
    ("What is lived (mya)?", "86-84"),
    ("What is length?", "7 m wingspan"),
    ("What is diet?", "piscivore"),
    ("What is found in?", "North America"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
